description: This bar chart, titled "Recall@10", illustrates the performance of three different interaction methods—labeled “- critiquing”, “- scoring”, and “- ranking”—measured by their Recall@10 score, which is plotted on the vertical y-axis with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.4 in increments of 0.1. The horizontal x-axis displays the three method categories, presented in a left-to-right order. The tallest bar, colored orange, corresponds to the “- critiquing” method and reaches a value of approximately 0.35 on the y-axis. The second bar, colored blue, represents the “- scoring” method and has a value of approximately 0.17. The third bar, also blue, represents the “- ranking” method and reaches a value of approximately 0.23. The first bar on the x-axis, labeled with a gray placeholder, is not associated with a method name and does not have a corresponding bar. The bars are arranged in the order of their labels and are not sorted by height. There are no visual emphasis or annotations on any of the bars.
